case_number: Fuleshwar Gope vs Union Of India
summary: Challenge to NIA investigation transfer, sanction order validity; UAPA sanction timelines (Rule 3, 2008 Rules) compliance; independent review requirement under Section 45(2) UAPA; absence of mens rea; appellant's non-involvement in company affairs; proviso to Section 22A UAPA exemption; High Court upheld jurisdiction and sanction legality; appeal against criminal prosecution quashing denial.
legal_provisions_cited: National Investigation Agency Act, 2008 s.6(2), s.6(3)
final_judgment: Pending; appeal filed against High Court judgment refusing to quash NIA proceedings, sanction order, and cognizance order.
